description: Diagnostic module that reads service_health for all daemons with last_heartbeat > 2h. For each stale daemon (write_service, self_diagnostics, rug_pull_monitor, wisdom_synthesiser): attempt to reconnect, log the heartbeat age, and emit a structured diagnostic dict {daemon, age_seconds, likely_cause, suggested_action}. Must NOT: restart services, modify supervisord configs, or propose rebuilds of protected files. Output diagnostic to stdout; write summary row to service_health with meta containing the full report. Targeted daemons per live wiring map snapshot.
